card.name: Spelled-out numbers before times, fold, or years
card.fires_on: Spelled-out small number words such as two, three, four or nine that come right before a unit or multiplier like times, fold, days, years, millennia or wide.

modes.label: Multiplier
modes.description: A number word before 'times' or 'fold' to show how much more or less likely something is.
modes.example: found that high-schoolers who cheat on tests are<< three>> times as likely to become workers who lie

modes.label: Span of time
modes.description: A number word before a period such as days, years or millennia.
modes.example: the murder of the president seemed to be a bloody, pointless coda to<< four>> years of conflict and instability.

modes.label: Measure
modes.description: A number word before a size or dimension word.
modes.example: is twelve miles long and<< nine>> wide.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of another English number word coming next and favors unit-like continuations such as time spans and 'plus' or 'digit' forms.
card.plain: It fires on a spelled-out number like two or three that is about to be followed by a unit such as times, days or years.
